## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; confirmation: very weak sector breadth plus mixed leadership across Tech, Healthcare and Energy, and notable 1W/1M divergences among large caps. Leadership concentration: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Technology steady: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication lagging: CMCSA (1W: -9.76% | 1M: -14.48%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND; ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.75%) CORRECTION and TSLA (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +3.75%) CORRECTION—watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed with pockets of leadership and short-term friction; AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND. Sector showing internal rotation rather than broad breakout; watch CORRECTION names like MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials under pressure with large-cap banks lagging; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND. Style note: cyclical/value names are not broadly leading this week—sector breadth weak.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare relatively constructive with leadership in med-tech and instruments; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Watch divergences in pharma: LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY and PFE (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -2.05%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Given NEUTRAL regime and weak breadth, favor selective exposure to names already ABOVE TREND in Tech and Healthcare (AMD, PANW, TMO, MPC) and reduce exposure to weak Communication and broad Financials. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor major-cap divergences before scaling core risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND; CMCSA (1W: -9.76% | 1M: -14.48%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare showing leadership (TMO, ISRG) amid positive news flow; Technology for idiosyncratic winners (AMD, PANW). BEARISH: Communication and Financials remain the most at risk given breadth and earnings/news flow.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch continuation signals rather than precise price targets: AMD sustaining 1M momentum (ABOVE TREND) = extension trigger; AAPL holding its 1M trend (ABOVE TREND) = market internals stabilizing; BAC/GS failing to arrest weekly decline (BELOW TREND) = downside risk to broad financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+75): EU approval headline; ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY — price confirming sentiment. MPC (+55): analyst upgrade/earnings beat; MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. TMO (+55): stronger demand commentary; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CVS (-85): fraud verdict headline; CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and risk elevated. BAC (-75): bond-loss headlines; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. PFE (-60): Medicaid pricing risk; PFE (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -2.05%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD, PANW and TMO showing relative strength (AMD ABOVE TREND; PANW ABOVE TREND; TMO ABOVE TREND). Key risk: breadth is very weak (2/11) and several mega-caps show 1W/1M divergences—watch for trend breaks and news-confirmation (e.g., CVS, BAC).
